_comment: Design 96 Pillar 1 — one row of the per-medium routing table on Agent Settings. A row says 'when an agent needs to produce THIS medium (an image, a rendered document, later video/audio), use THAT provider' — independent of the text provider each agent chats with. Kept as a child table on the Agent Settings singleton (same one-admin-surface pattern as default_provider) rather than per-profile fields, because a site typically has ONE image provider shared by every visual agent.

fields.label: Medium
fields.description: What kind of output this route covers. 'text' rows are honored but rarely needed — text already resolves through each agent's own provider chain; leave text un-routed for the standard behaviour.

fields.label: LLM Provider
fields.description: The provider that handles this medium. Its own fallback_provider chain (Design 94) still applies — routing composes with failover.

name: Model Route
